description: This file defines the main React route component for the recipe explorer frontend. It manages fetching and displaying recipes, filter controls, and a modal for recipe details. It also includes a custom hook for managing recipe data fetching.

methods.name: useRecipes
methods.description: Custom hook that manages fetching recipes using RecipesService; provides recipe list, loading state, error state, and functions to fetch data.

methods.name: HomeRoute
methods.description: Main React component for the home route, displaying recipe grid, filters, and recipe detail modal.
